url.label: Address
url.description: An http(s) address that answers JSON or plain text.

format.label: Answer format
format.description: Text: the whole answer is shown, a number like a number, and the path is not used.

path.label: Path to the number
path.description: Keys with dots, list items in brackets: data.result[0].value[1].

yellow.label: Yellow from
yellow.description: The number turns yellow at this value and above. 0 turns it off.

red.label: Red from
red.description: The number turns red at this value and above. 0 turns it off.

auth.label: Authorization header
auth.description: Sent as is when not empty, like Bearer <token>.
